intelligence.human_view: The greeting is a welcome, not a page: it says hello and gets out of the way, and what is left is clean like software — search, three doors, categories, nothing explaining itself. The sidebar balance is the same idea at the edges: even on either side, nothing doubled, nothing the same colour twice in a row, the things you reach for first (My Worlds — create your world first) sitting where the hand falls. And the social-network feel is the shape he has been circling all day: Facebook's structure, but different, ours.
intelligence.simple_view: When you come in, the Hub says good afternoon and shows you the time — and then it folds itself away, all tidy, so you just see the search and your doors. Clean and simple, like real software!
intelligence.grandma_view: When you come in, dear, the Hub says good afternoon and shows you the time — and then it folds itself away, all tidy, so you just see the search and your doors. Clean and simple, like real software!
intelligence.naya_view: THE HUB WELCOME FOLDS AWAY: IT GREETS YOU — GOOD AFTERNOON, TIME, QUOTE OF THE DAY — THEN IT FOLDS UP AND HIDES AWAY. UNDERNEATH, FLUSH: SEARCH, COLLECTIVE / PERSONAL / ACTIVITY, THEN THE CATEGORIES. SIDEBARS BALANCED, EVEN ON EITHER SIDE. THE BEST INTERFACE IS THE ONE THAT FOLDS UP AND HIDES AWAY.
